displayName: Nordstrom Rack Product Data API - Clearance, Flash Events, Store Pickup, Reviews
description: Nordstrom Rack product data as structured JSON - search nordstromrack.com, list any /shop or /clearance category, Clear the Rack, flash events or a brand page with filter counts, read price, compare-at price, percent off, the clearance price and any extra-off promotion price on top, read one product with every size and color as a SKU with UPC, price type, stock and units available to ship plus the star histogram, size-fit distribution and the reviews shown on the page, pull Rack's own review history (up to 200 per call) sorted and filtered by stars, verified purchase, photos or text, check per-SKU ship and Rack store-pickup availability with the stores that can do pickup, find Nordstrom Rack stores near a ZIP with hours, and pull search autocomplete. 8 endpoints, 5 credits each, availability and reviews 10.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
